patch.title: Smalling: 600 MW Solar Interconnection Request J2519 — Withdrawn
patch.longFormSummary:
• J2519 is a 600 MW photovoltaic generation interconnection request in Richland, LA. The grid operator lists its queue status as Withdrawn. The requested in-service date is 2026-10-31; this is a planning date.
  • The point of interconnection is Smalling. Queue processing status does not establish physical construction or commercial operation.
  • No exact-scope construction budget is published in the cited grid record. Battery power is distinct from stored energy; no four-hour duration or battery MWh is inferred.

The MISO queue was checked on October 30, 2026 and records this request as withdrawn. The actual withdrawal date is not published; the timeline milestone records the date checked.
